title: Ryan's paladin, level 1-3
subtitle: New at 1: 1 Seal of Righteousness, Shift-F Holy Light, Alt-H Hearthstone, Alt-Q Devotion Aura
summary: Ryan's leveling plan as of level 1. New: 1 Seal of Righteousness, Shift-F Holy Light, Alt-H Hearthstone, Alt-Q Devotion Aura.
notes: Apply the step that matches your level. Spells you haven't learned yet are skipped.
Keys only get reassigned as you level, so applying the next step over this one is safe.
Seal of Justice and Seal of Fury get pushed off the keys by level 36. Cast them from the spellbook if you need them.
